sampling.sampled_count: count() of retained rows; this is the sufficiency floor
sampling.estimated_count: sum(_sample_interval); never used to satisfy the sample floor
sampling.caveat: sampled_count and estimated_count are estimates with different meanings; neither is a unique visitor count. No confidence interval is claimed.

retention.provider: Analytics Engine retains about three months
retention.partial_rule: A requested interval that starts before availability is retention_partial and omits percentiles.

diagnoses.how: Weighted current window meets the retained-row floor. Read p50/p75/p95 beside sampled_count.
Retained count() is below RUM_MIN_SAMPLED_ROWS. A large estimated_count does not rescue the distribution. Wait for more retained rows.
Instrumented selection has zero observations in the window. This is not a numeric zero and not a coverage gap.
The registered surface or component is not yet instrumented. Register and instrument it; do not treat this as no_data.
Intake rejected unknown_surface or unknown_component. Add the route to the canonical registry; never map it to home.
The requested window starts before RUM_MEASURED_SINCE or exceeds the 90-day bound. Shorten the window.
Missing Analytics Engine credentials, SQL failure, or overflow. Check Worker bindings; do not display zeros.
